lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters arranged in a semi-regular grid posterior to the gill slits, with a higher spatial frequency of local maxima concentrated along the mid-lateral axis.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs to form a visible rectilinear coordinate-like system across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal ridges running horizontally across the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical pixel intensity gradient with high-luminance highlights on the dorsal side and low-luminance shadows on the ventral side.
